name: Witch Doctor Dark Loa's Incantation: three-mobs (#4169)
contract: Dark Loa's Incantation 525377 (CharacterAdvancement 6073, Shadowhunting specialization 4) promises: Dealing damage with Shadowflare now applies Hex of Malice if it strikes at least three enemies. Shadowflare 801669 has an 8-yard radius, target UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY and a trigger-with-value effect that the class contract converts to direct SCHOOL_DAMAGE. The converted effect must still hit enemies in its authored area.

Training dummy 31146 uses npc_training_dummy: native damage is logged, then DamageTaken clamps its health loss to zero. Successful damaging strikes on dummies must count toward the same three-target condition as strikes on mobs. Absorbed or immune hits are not established by this case. Untalented and two-target casts must not apply Hex; three mobs, three dummies, and a mixed set must all receive the caster's Hex. A friendly creature inside and a hostile creature beyond eight yards are controls. Counts belong to a single cast; two-target casts repeated independently must never combine into a three-target proc.

The talent uses a native specialization and advancement upload. The caster learns the ordinary Shadowflare and Hex rank-one spells as fixtures, preserves cast time, cost and GCD, and uses spell hit rating to exclude random misses. Per-target native damage logs establish delivery even when dummy health is unchanged; Hex auras establish the talent payload.
